DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple System Atrophy (MSA).

The clinical presentation of autonomic dysfunction (orthostatic hypotension), cerebellar signs (dysarthria, ataxia), and extrapyramidal features (rigidity, tremor) is highly characteristic of this atypical Parkinsonian syndrome. Since the MRI Spine images were not provided in the latest data, I am requesting them to definitively rule out structural compression causing similar symptoms.
